name: reference-brief
title: Draft internal reference brief
for_each: select id,code from requests where status='open'

sections.title: Assignment and current permission
sections.note: Internal only. Read restrictions and confirm the advocate accepted this audience before sharing. An empty assignment means nobody has been chosen.
sections.sql: select a.name,a.company,x.status,p.decision,p.valid_until,p.restrictions from assignments x join advocates a on a.id=x.advocate_id join requests r on r.id=x.request_id left join current_permissions p on p.advocate_id=a.id and p.kind=r.kind where x.request_id=$1 and x.status in ('proposed','accepted')

sections.title: Current exceptions
sections.sql: select c.record,c.rule,c.finding from compliance_findings c where c.record_id in (select id from assignments where request_id=$1) or c.record_id in (select advocate_id from assignments where request_id=$1)

name: permission-review
title: Draft permission review sheet
for_each: select id,name from advocates where status<>'archived'

sections.title: Permission record
sections.sql: select kind,decision,valid_until,evidence,restrictions,actor from current_permissions where advocate_id=$1 order by kind

sections.title: Checks
sections.sql: select rule,finding from compliance_findings where record_id=$1

name: story-pack
title: Draft approved wording pack
for_each: select id,title from story_library where usable

sections.title: Approved wording
sections.note: Internal draft. Recheck current permissions before publication. No content is published by this tool.
sections.sql: select title,name,company,body,valid_until,restrictions from story_library where id=$1 and usable
